Chapter 6926: Mercy

Chapter 6926: Mercy

“Save me!” The frightened octopus panicked due to his helpless state.

Earlier, he killed emperors and ancient ancestors effortlessly. Now, he suffered the same fate.

Normally, an overlord could still implode in this situation, destroying his true fate and injuring the immortal. This would prevent his mind from being captured and twisted.

“Immortal, please be merciful.” Timeflow asked again since removing the ocean of consciousness meant true death. The octopus would not be able to create his true fate again outside of a miracle.

Li Qiye tossed the true fate to the ground.

“Thank you, Immortal, thank you.” Timeflow was drenched in sweat since this could have been him.

The frightened Cerulean never felt death so close before. This was not his first time facing death, but this feeling of helplessness was unprecedented.

“Now, will you talk?” Li Qiye asked.

“Perpetual Immortal, it was Perpetual Immortal.” He blurted, no longer having any pride or arrogance.

“Perpetual Immortal.” Timeflow frowned.

“Although I didn’t witness it, I know this is completely accurate. Perpetual Immortal sealed two ladies and took them away.” Cerulean said: “I know the ladies are from the nine worlds so he thought they were valuable.”

“I swear this is all true.” He repeated.

“Perpetual Immortal?” Li Qiye said.

“Immortal, Perpetual Immortal is Breaker Immortal’s direct disciple, a being on the same level as my grandmaster, another master of Ancient.” Timeflow said.

“So many masters, I see.” Li Qiye smirked.

Timeflow became frozen. For some reason, he feared Li Qiye more than anyone. Perhaps his grandmaster still couldn’t protect him.

“Yes, there are three primordial immortals in charge of Ancient. My grandmaster is one, Breaker Immortal, and Apex Immortal.” He said, not daring to waste time: “But, my grandmaster is different from Breaker Immortal.”

“How so?” Li Qiye smiled.

“My grandmaster seeks a dao equal to the heaven. Breaker Immortal, on the other hand, follows the path of destruction.” He said.

He was a destroyer, not a devourer. Numerous worlds have shattered before his path. Some believed that he had killed more than the majority of immortals in Devouring Alliance.

An immortal in Heavenrealm believed that only five or more cultivators had massacred more living beings, hence his notoriety.

Overlords and immortals from other firmaments didn’t dare to offend him. After all, doing so might risk the destruction of several firmaments.
